_README: WHAT THIS GAME PLAYS, STATED AS DATA. Dawnblade is a fan-made sub-format
of Flesh and Blood's Silver Age, declared by the project owner on
2026-09-26. Its pool is FROZEN at the fifteen Chapter 1-3 precons as
printed, and it does NOT follow Silver Age's rolling ban list or its
seasonal hero bench: a card Silver Age has since banned, or a hero it has
benched, stays legal here. That is a choice about which game this is, not
THE SILVER AGE LEGALITY BLOCK IS DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED (v6.23).
`node tools/silver-age.js` reads the pinned card database (data/pool.js)
and writes `silverAge`; `test/formats.test.js` fails if the block drifts
from what the tool derives. It records what the upstream DATABASE says,
not the official announcements (unreachable from this project's cloud
sandbox; DESKTOP-TASKS.md keeps the residual). `benched` is `null` because
the data has no hero-bench field: null reads as 'not recorded', and an
empty list would read as 'no hero is benched', which is not known.

dawnblade.name: Dawnblade
dawnblade.kind: a fan-made sub-format of Silver Age
dawnblade.pool: the fifteen Silver Age Chapter 1-3 preconstructed decks exactly as printed (window.DECKS), plus the tokens and Demi-Heroes their cards create
dawnblade.legality: every card and every hero in the pool is legal, whatever Silver Age's own ban list or hero bench says
dawnblade.rules: the Flesh and Blood Comprehensive Rules as this engine encodes them; every stated deviation is a record in tools/approx.js

_why: Silver Age's legality is recorded BESIDE the format, never inside it:
it is information a player may want (which of these cards would they
not be allowed at a Silver Age event) and it changes every season, while
DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED: tools/silver-age.js reads `silver_age_banned` and
`silver_age_banned_start` off the pinned card database (data/pool.js), for the
cards and heroes the fifteen precons play. This is the upstream DATABASE's
statement as of the last re-pin, NOT a reading of fabtcg.com's announcements
(still unreachable from the sandbox; see DESKTOP-TASKS.md).
HEROES: the database marks a hero 'banned' (`kind: hero`) and has no separate
hero-bench field, so a seasonal bench is recorded here as a ban, in the
database's own words, with no 'until' date (the data carries none).
`benched` stays null: the data does not distinguish a bench from a ban.
